doremy_lbol.name: Doremy Sweet (Lost Branch of Legend)
doremy_lbol.description: The ruler of dreams, growing stronger the longer it takes her to awaken. April Fools character based on her Lost Branch of Legend fight

funbro.name: Solidad's Slowbro
funbro.description: The ride never ends. April Fools character based off of the "Funbro" strategy.

kebako.name: Kebako
kebako.description: April Fools character that's just Sagat.

maple_black_mage.name: Black Mage
maple_black_mage.description: Joke character based on a major Maplestory boss fight. Very simulationist

redhood_squigly.name: Silent Redhood & Squigly
redhood_squigly.description: Inspired by Aevusonian's "tag-team" joke concept, where the effects of two characters' cards are forcefully combined. Squigly design by Bluellama1

rouxls.name: Rouxls Kaard
rouxls.description: April Fools character; minor spoilers for Deltarune Chapter 1-3. Lots of rules

scary_orange.name: Scary Orange
scary_orange.description: April Fools character because everyone kept asking me to make them. The eighth attack's existence is a bit more obscured in the TTS object

siivagunner.name: SiIvagunner
siivagunner.description: April Fools character based on a YouTube channel famous for mash-ups. Largely made because I wanted to experiment with the modified layout on Antonymph

spiegelmann.name: Spiegelmann
spiegelmann.description: April Fools character inspired by the inconsistency of upgrade systems in Maplestory. Made before I had a solid concept for the season as a whole

tic_tac_turmoil.name: That Girl
tic_tac_turmoil.description: April Fools character from Tic-Tac-Turmoil, draining your life with a twisted version of Tic Tac Toe. Has a lot of specials

tlsc.name: The Legendary Super Citrus
tlsc.description: April Fools character I was forced to make. Borrows pieces of designs by Bluellama1 and Vylok

arcanist.name: Royal Arcanist
arcanist.description: A sorcerer with an arsenal of powerful curses, hoping to have adventures with her friends for as long as she can

depths.name: Depth's Secret
depths.description: An aquatic monster whose attacks grow larger over time, threatening to swallow you whole

frost.name: Hero of Frost
frost.description: A swordfighter with balanced offense and defense, relying on her footwork to corner opponents

lich.name: Lich of Flowers
lich.description: A newly turned monster who controls flowers and butterflies, slowly amassing a wall of summons to overwhelm opponents

redhood.name: Silent Redhood
redhood.description: A stoic and stealthy rogue, setting traps for opponents that limit their options to escape her

storm.name: Stormbeast
storm.description: A wild and aggresive monster, using her doppelganger and lightspeed movement to attack from all directions

sunny.name: Sun Priestess
sunny.description: A cleric adventurer with long-ranged holy magic and a lot of secrets

wyrm.name: Dreadwyrm Heir
wyrm.description: A draconic monarch, blasting opponents with firey projectiles that are stronger up close

angelic_buster.name: Angelic Buster
angelic_buster.description: Magical Girl/Idol who formed a pact with Eskalade for the power to fight alongside Kaiser. Punches and shoots things into pink explosions

battle_mage.name: Battle Mage
battle_mage.description: Resistance soldier who weilds dark magical auras to support allies and strike enemies in close combat

beast_tamer.name: Beast Tamer
beast_tamer.description: Girl who fights alongside her four animal companions, calling upon their unique talents as need arises. No longer playable in Maplestory but I think they're funny

bishop.name: Bishop
bishop.description: Classical healer magician archetype, with lower damage but a wide array of strong supportive buffs

bowmaster.name: Bowmaster
bowmaster.description: Archer who rains rapid-fire shots on their opponents from safe distances

buccaneer.name: Buccaneer
buccaneer.description: Mobile up-close bruiser whose punches and kicks harness the power of the sea (and dragons)

cadena.name: Cadena
cadena.description: Former Nova princess who turned to the rougher Shadowdealer life and seeks revenge. Smoothly weaves between chain attacks and an arsenal of summoned weapons

dawn_warrior.name: Dawn Warrior
dawn_warrior.description: Sword-wielding Cygnus Knight, though her style has diverged from Mihile. Shifts stances with every attack, striking unrelentingly with the power of the cosmos

demon_avenger.name: Demon Avenger
demon_avenger.description: Demon who formerly worked for the Black Mage, choosing to harness a new power in his quest for vengeance. Unleashes strong attacks at the cost of his own health

demon_slayer.name: Demon Avenger
demon_slayer.description: Demon who formerly worked for the Black Mage, choosing to hone his original power in his quest for vengeance. Builds up energy with basic attacks that his stronger techniques harness in bursts

evan.name: Evan
evan.description: The successor to an ancient hero, combining his magic with his dragon Mir's powers to create countless attack fusions

fire_poison.name: Archmage of Fire/Poison
fire_poison.description: Magician specializing in single-target damage, stacking various poisons and debuffs until the time comes to make them all explode

hero.name: Hero
hero.description: The classic swordfighter, walking up to his targets and swinging with his strongest skill

hoyoung.name: Hoyoung
hoyoung.description: The apprentice of a legendary sage, working alongside the evil spirit he befriended to seal the fiends he accidentally unleashed. Converts various forms of energy into others to power his skills

ice_lightning.name: Archmage of Ice/Lightning
ice_lightning.description: Magician specializing in wide-area magic, sealing opponents' movements with ice that they then shatter with lightning

kanna.name: Kanna
kanna.description: Onmyouji with four shikigami, able to wield their full power only in short bursts to great effect. Exceed deck includes an experimental tool to let you "upgrade" your card names when bursting

kanna_prime.name: Kanna (Prime Form)
kanna_prime.description: An older form of Kanna, from when she completely controlled the metagame of Maplestory. Uses an extremely strong economy to power strange and strong tools

khali.name: Khali
khali.description: A former soldier of the High Flora, seeking to avenge the family they took from her. Dashes around her enemies to strike with chakrams from their blind spots

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.description: Fires strong, precise crossbow shots that become intensified when repeated

mercedes.name: Mercedes
mercedes.description: The queen of the elves, firing her dual bowguns constantly as she dances through enemy attacks

mihile.name: Mihile
mihile.description: The captain of the Cygnus Knights, fully devoted to protecting his empress. Guards through attacks with his shield so that he never has to let the pressure up

night_lord.name: Night Lord
night_lord.description: A shuriken-throwing ninja, evasively biding his time until he can rush in with his strongest techniques

wild_hunter.name: Wild Hunter
wild_hunter.description: A Resistance soldier, fighting atop or alongside their tamed Jaguars while firing crossbows and various explosives.

zero.name: Zero
zero.description: Alpha and Beta, the twin children of the Transcendant of Time. Rapidly tag each other in and out of combat to outlast and overwhelm enemies

coo.name: Coo
coo.description: A hungry dragon child who you can raise to use her powers and appetite for good or chaos. From DRAPLINE, though made before it fully released

jevil.name: Jevil
jevil.description: A chaotic jester who finds freedom in reckless violence. From DELTARUNE; I'll probably work on a full season once it's done releasing, which may influence this design

kumoko.name: Kumoko
kumoko.description: A reincarnated spider who rapidly outgrows her habitat in her struggle to survive. From I'm A Spider, So What?; made for April Fools but a legitimate design attempt

mami_old.name: Futatsuiwa Mamizou
mami_old.description: An old design heavily based on her appearance in Antinomy of Common Flower, made for a design jam. One of my first customs; will probably be redone entirely if I revisit it

miia.name: Miia
miia.description: An ordinary lovestruck lamia girl, fighting over her beloved's affection with her housemates. From Monster Musume (NSFW); made for April Fools but a legitimate design attempt

narmaya.name: Narmaya
narmaya.description: Skilled and disciplined swordswoman, swapping between stances to adapt to the situation. Based (primarily) on Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising; made for a community season

papi.name: Papi
papi.description: A scatterbrained but straightforward harpy girl, fighting over her beloved's affection with her housemates. From Monster Musume (NSFW); made for April Fools but a legitimate design attempt

rimuru.name: Rimuru Tempest
rimuru.description: A reincarnated slime, growing stronger by absorbing the powers of those they defeat and befriend. From Slime Tensura; made for April Fools but a legitimate design attempt

ampharos.name: Emma's Ampharos
ampharos.description: A detective and her far-reaching electric partner. Inspired by how Ampharos played Pokemon Legends ZA

meowstic.name: Olympia's Meowstic
meowstic.description: A cat with various supportive abilities to combat the threats he forsees. Exploration of how to represent "support" characters.

serperior.name: Rosa's Serperior
serperior.description: Builds up power with every Leaf Storm they unleash. One of my first customs; relatively simulationist

absa.name: Absa
absa.description: The protector of the peaceful remnants of the Air society. Floats through the air to control space with clouds and strike with precise attacks

orcane.name: Orcane
orcane.description: A playful and stealthy trickster who can manipulate and transform into water. Lays down puddles that he uses to corner or surprise opponents with strong tools

zetterburn.name: Zetterburn
zetterburn.description: The prince of the Firelands, strong in battle but naive to its politics. Consumes the flames he ignites the opponent with to deal massive damage

inkling.name: Inkling / Agent 3
inkling.description: An enthusiastic and highly mobile squid-kid, swimming through the ink they shoot. Made for a design jam as a counterpart to Octoling

octoling.name: Octoling / Agent 8
octoling.description: An analytical and highly mobile octopus-kid, swimming through the ink they shoot. Made for a design jam as a counterpart to Inkling

off_the_hook.name: Off The Hook
off_the_hook.description: A musical idol duo, harnessing the apparent clash between Pearl's talent for metal/rap and Marina's melodic pop style. Made in the spirit of Dolphin's Vocal Synth customs

squid_sisters.name: Squid Sisters
squid_sisters.description: A musical idol duo, exhibiting the well practiced synchronization between the bubbly Callie and calm Marie. Made in the spirit of Dolphin's Vocal Synth customs

junko.name: Junko
junko.description: Divine spirit who has purified herself of everything but her hatred for the Lunarians. Aims to kill opponents in the most straightforward and efficient way possible

kokoro.name: Hata no Kokoro
kokoro.description: A youkai of masks who (used to) rely on them to express any emotion. Her attacks are connected to specific masks, influencing her approach to the strike that follows

lily.name: Lily White
lily.description: Fairy who heralds the arrival of Spring. Does so by firing bullets indiscriminately

marisa.name: Kirisame Marisa
marisa.description: An ordinary magician with big lasers. Card frame commissioned by Jungy, made by Fakey, and applied to Marisa by Moriatti. If you're looking for Reimu, Aevusonian made her (several times)

ran.name: Yakumo Ran
ran.description: Nine-tailed kitsune who serves as the Shikigami of a powerful youkai. Is herself able to control Shikigami, making use of summons as well as physical augmentation in battle

seija.name: Kijin Seija
seija.description: An amanojaku who strives to oppose everything and everyone she meets. Turns rules on their head to frustrate the opponent above all else

suika.name: Ibuki Suika
suika.description: An oni with a bottomless gourd of sake. Uses her density manipulation in various ways to influence gravity, mass, and volume (she gets big and punches you)

suwako.name: Moriya Suwako
suwako.description: An ancient goddess of the earth who generally works in the background but enjoys friendly competition. My favorite touhou

consul_n.name: Consul N
consul_n.description: One of the overseers of Aionios, aiming to perpetuate its endless cycle of war to sustain his own life and desires

mio.name: Mio
mio.description: An off-seer from Agnes, struggling to come to terms with her own approaching predetermined death. Protects her allies by drawing aggression and evading attacks

noah.name: Mio
noah.description: An off-seer from Keves, seeking a way to end his world's endless war. Searches for openings to land decisive hits against his opponents
